data.name: Chronos Affinity
data.detailed_description:
THE OPERATIVE’S JOURNEY

"They say every war begins long before the first shot is fired.

For you, it begins the moment you step into the boots of a Private Military Contractor—a lone operative navigating a world where truth is buried beneath layers of corruption, betrayal, and corporate warfare.

Your PMC is your identity, your story, your legacy."


Storyline Character

The PMC mode is your storyline character. It is an interactive story-driven mode where you will be tasked with finding out information, meeting key figures, completing storyline quests, and ultimately trying to beat the game. Infill, loot, fight, extract.

High Rewards

Uncover hidden networks and buried intelligence. Forge alliances with powerful figures. Complete high‑risk missions that shape the fate of entire regions. Piece together a truth someone is desperate to keep buried. Your decisions echo far beyond the battlefield. And when your story reaches its end… a new war begins.


"The Ghosts In The System"

Some call them ghosts. Others call them a myth. Those who've crossed them know better. Delta Cell is a covert tactical unit operating outside every known chain of command. No insignias. No records. No confirmed leadership.

Tactical Response Team

Your purpose is singular: Disrupt. Sabotage. Erase. Failure carries consequences. Success brings rewards. And every extraction shapes the balance of power. In short, HUNT AND KILL THE PMC's. They must not know the truth.

Loot Mechanics

You will be able to loot and bring items from raid back to your PMC's stash as a Delta Cell operative. Gear and weapons worn by your Delta Cell operative are not able to be transferred to your stash with the exception of the team leaders.

The Final Conflict

All‑Out War is the culmination of everything you’ve built—every skill earned, every weapon secured, every truth uncovered. This is the open battlefield, the unrestrained conflict where PMC's collide and survival becomes the only law. This mode is locked until storyline completion

Just The Beginning

in this mode, you will: Deploy accross every map, raid, fight, loot, and carve your place in the leaderboards. Unlock new quest lines and better rewards. Choose a trader and follow their instructions for unique game endings. And i forgot to mention. It pays to be a winner.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 or 1650
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700-XT or Nvidia RTX 3060Ti
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X: DX12
